pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with moderately sharp edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the lateral shoulder and decreases towards the ventral midline where shapes become smaller and more rounded.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space graph formed by light cream pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathways exhibit high continuity and relatively uniform thickness across the visible thoracic and cervical regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Upper neck mane presents as a dark, short-haired silhouette with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged edge profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Four avian organisms (oxpeckers) are attached to the subject: one on the dorsal mane, one on the mid-lateral neck, and two on the ventral-lateral chest.
